about.title: Ebitukwatako
paras: Buganda Investments and Commercial Undertakings Limited (BICUL) egenderera okufuna ensimbi nga eyita mu kwenyigira mu kusiga ensimbi okusaanidde era okw'omuganyulo n'emirimu gy'obusuubuzi, okusobola okuwa ensimbi oba okugattako ku nsimbi z'enteekateeka za Buganda ez'enkulaakulana mu by'enfuna, mu by'embeera z'abantu, ne mu buwangwa.

BICUL ekola omulimu gwayo omukulu ng'ekitongole ky'Obwakabaka ekirina emigabo (holding company) mu kampuni ez'enjawulo ezikola ebintu n'okuwa obuweereza, n'okukuuma obuwangwa, ku lw'omuganyulo gw'Obwakabaka.

why.title: Lwaki Osiga Ensimbi mu Buganda?
why.lead: Obwakabaka bwa Buganda bwe bwakabaka obw'ennono obusinga obunene mu Uganda ey'ennaku zino, nga butwaliramu ekitundu kya Uganda kyonna eky'Amasekkati, omuli n'ekibuga ekikulu Kampala, era nga kirimu abantu nga obukadde 10. Ekifo eky'enkizo eky'Obwakabaka wakati mu ggwanga kiyumba emirimu mingi egyekyusa okusinziira ku mbeera, ekiyamba okusiga ensimbi okw'amaanyi.
why.question: Oyinza okwebuuza nti, lwaki Buganda
reasons: 70% ku by'obusuubuzi, oba ebyamaguzi n'obuweereza, bikolebwa mu bbanga lya kiromita 50–80 okwetooloola, era ekitundu ekyo kyonna kiri mu Buganda.
Obunyiikivu, okwagala n'obwesigwa bw'abantu ba Buganda eri Kabaka waabwe n'Obwakabaka biri mu musaayi gwabwe. Ojja kufuna omukisa ogukakasiddwa okutuuka ku kitundu kino eky'akatale.
Obukulembeze bw'Obwakabaka obuliwo kati bukola nnyo, bulina obuyinza, bwenyigira mu mirimu, era bukozesa obukugu obw'amaanyi
Obwakabaka bwa Buganda bulina ettaka lingi eririmu amazzi, ebibira n'amayinja ag'enjawulo, n'ebirala

Ettaka erimu liri mu kibuga ekikulu ne mu bibuga ebirala (ery'omuwendo ennyo ku pulojekiti ez'omutindo ogwa waggulu); so nga mu byalo mulimu ettaka eddene erisaanira okulimirako ku mutendera gw'obusuubuzi.
closing: Olw'okubaawo kw'enkola ennungi ez'eby'enfuna ez'eggwanga n'embeera ennungi ennyo ey'okusiga ensimbi, okakasa okufuna amagoba amalungi ku nsimbi z'osiga, naddala bw'osalawo okukolagana n'ekitongole ekyesigika nga ffe.
Tukwaniriza okulowooza ku kukola emirimu gy'obusuubuzi naffe.

divisions.title: Ekitongole ky'Ebibalo
divisions.lead: Ekitongole ky'Ebibalo gwe mpagi ey'enkola ennywevu ey'ebibalo n'okusalawo mu Bwakabaka bwa Buganda.
paras: Obwetaavu bw'ebibalo bumanyiddwa ng'ekintu ekikulu ennyo era ekyetaagisa mu nteekateeka zonna ez'enkulaakulana.
Ekitongole ky'Ebibalo kifugibwa olukiiko lw'abantu abalondeddwa, omuli abakugu mu bibalo basatu ab'erinnya n'abakungu basatu okuva mu Gavumenti y'Obwakabaka:

Etteeka erilung'amya emirimu gy'ebibalo mu Uganda lye Tteeka lya Uganda Bureau of Statistics (Juuni 1998). Etteeka lino lilaga enzimba y'Enkola y'Ebibalo ey'Eggwanga (NSS) n'emirimu gy'abeetabamu ab'enjawulo

Uganda Bureau of Statistics (UBOS) yalonda Mw. James Muwonge, Akulira Ekitongole ky'Obuweereza bw'Abakugu (Professional Services Unit), okubeera Omukungu omutongole akwasaganya, okuwagira n'okulung'amya Ekitongole kya Buganda eky'Ebibalo.

Waliwo essuubi lingi nti nga Gavumenti ya Uganda, abagabi b'obuyambi, ebitongole ebitali bya gavumenti (NGOs), n'abalala abakwatibwako beeyongera okuwagira, Ekitongole kya Buganda eky'Ebibalo kijja kutuukiriza ekigendererwa kyakyo mu bujjuvu.

Ekitongole kya Buganda eky'Ebibalo kyebaza nnyo Minisitule zonna, Ebitongole, Ebiwayi, n'abantu kinnoomu b'ekikolagana nabo. BSU esiima nnyo obuwagizi bwabwe obutakyuka, okukolagana, n'okuzzibwamu amaanyi.

divisions.title: Ekitongole ky'Enkolagana ez'Enkizo
divisions.lead: Ekitongole ky'Enkolagana ez'Enkizo kyatandikibwawo ng'ekitongole munda mu Buganda Investment and Commercial Undertaking Limited (BICUL) okusikiriza bannamukago mu by'enkulaakulana abatakola lwa magoba.
paras: Ekigendererwa ekikulu ekya SPU kwe kunoonyereza ku mikago egisaanidde n'emikisa gy'ensimbi ez'obuyambi okuva mu bwesige obw'obwannannyini (private trusts), ebibiina by'obuyambi, ebitongole ebitali bya gavumenti (NGOs) n'ebitongole bya gavumenti ebikwatibwako. Ekitongole kino kinoonya era kisikiriza ebitongole ebigaba obuyambi, nga kizimba emikago era nga kizzaamu amaanyi abawagizi abeetegefu era abanoonya okuwaayo ensimbi mu ngeri y'obuyambi n'ebirabo, awamu n'emikago, okuyamba Buganda okulongoosa n'okutuusa obuweereza ku bantu ab'emitendera egya wansi mu bitundu byonna eby'obuweereza. Mu kuyamba ku nteekateeka enkulu ey'enkulaakulana, SPU egenderera okusinga ennyo “Okutondawo Obugagga n'okulongoosa embeera z'abantu abawangaala mu Buganda. SPU ekolagana ne Minisitule zonna eza Buganda ng'emikutu gy'okutuusa obuweereza.
divisions.vision: Okuteeka Obwakabaka bwa Buganda mu kifo eky'enkizo ng'omunnamukago omukulu mu kuteeka mu nkola obuweereza, okutuuka mu mwaka 2020
divisions.mission: Okulabirira emirimu gy'ensimbi ez'obuyambi mu Bwakabaka, omuli okuzuula n'okutegeeza ku mikisa gy'ensimbi egikwatagana mu budde, okukwasaganya ebyetaagisa n'okuwa obuyambi mu kukola embalirira, okuddukanya endagaano, enteekateeka, n'okunoonyereza mu kiseera ky'okusaba ensimbi ez'obuyambi, okulondoola n'okukakasa nti amateeka gagobererwa ku nsimbi ez'obuyambi eziweereddwa.
objectives: Okwanjula n'okulanga Obwakabaka bwa Buganda n'enzimba yaabwo eri abagabi b'obuyambi.
Okunoonya ensimbi okuwagira pulojekiti ez'enjawulo ne Minisitule ezijja okulongoosa embeera z'abantu mu Bwakabaka bwa Buganda.
Okutondawo n'okukuuma emikago egy'enkizo n'ebitongole ebinene eby'enkulaakulana.
Okuyamba ku buwangaazi bw'Obwakabaka bwa Buganda mu by'ensimbi ne mu bitongole byabwo.
Okukakasa obuvunaanyizibwa n'okutuukiriza pulojekiti ku nsimbi zonna eziweebwa.
divisions.summary: Okukwatagana n'abagabi b'obuyambi ne bannamukago olw'enkulaakulana eva mu nsimbi ez'obuyambi, n'okutumbula enkolagana ezireeta enkulaakulana ey'olubeerera mu Bwakabaka bwonna.

divisions.title: Ekitongole ky'Okukuza Emirimu Emipya
divisions.lead: Ekitongole ky'Okukuza Emirimu Emipya kye kitongole ekikulembera munda mu Buganda Investments and Commercial Undertaking Limited (BICUL) mu kukuza ebirowoozo n'enteekateeka ebigendereddwamu okwongera ku mirimu n'emigabo Obwakabaka gye bwasigamu ensimbi.
paras: Ekitongole ky'Okukuza Emirimu Emipya kissa essira ku kunywereza okwenyigira mu kusiga ensimbi okusaanidde era okw'omuganyulo n'emirimu gy'obusuubuzi, okusobola okuwa ensimbi oba okugattako ku nsimbi z'enteekateeka za Buganda ez'enkulaakulana mu by'enfuna, mu by'embeera z'abantu, ne mu buwangwa. Kitongole ekiyiiya ebirowoozo, ekissa essira ku kutandikawo, okufuna, okukola ku, n'okulondoola okuteeka mu nkola pulojekiti eziba zikkiriziddwa enzimba y'Obukulembeze bw'Obwakabaka.

Ekitongole kinoonya era kisikiriza abasizi b'ensimbi abayinza okujja ku mikisa gy'okusiga ensimbi egiriwo, mu kunoonya n'okukulaakulanya emikisa gy'obusuubuzi egirimu akabi, nga bwe tuyamba okutuukiriza Enteekateeka Enkulu ey'Obwakabaka. Nga kikolagana ne minisitule n'ebitongole bya Buganda byonna okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kyaffe, ekitongole kino gwe mukutu gw'Obwakabaka ogugezesa ebintu ebipya, ogusobozesa okwolekera ebitamanyiddwa, okugezesa ebirowoozo ebipya, n'okukola n'obugumiikiriza n'obwangu bungi.
divisions.vision: Okuteeka Obwakabaka bwa Buganda mu kifo eky'enkizo ng'omunnamukago omukulu mu kusiga ensimbi, ng'essira liri ku kutuuka ku nkulaakulana ey'olubeerera etwaliramu buli muntu, nga bwe butuukiriza obweyamo bwabwo obw'okutwala Buganda ku ntikko.
divisions.mission: Okwongera ku buwanguzi mu kutandikawo emirimu n'enteekateeka empya, okutondawo emirimu n'okuwa abantu emirimu mu bitundu ebikwatagana n'emikisa egy'enjawulo Obwakabaka gye bulina.
objectives: Okutegeka n'okwanjula emikisa egy'enjawulo egy'okusiga ensimbi egiri mu Bwakabaka bwa Buganda eri abasizi b'ensimbi ab'omunda mu ggwanga n'ab'ebweru abayinza okujja.
Okwenyigira mu kutandikawo kampuni empya ez'obuyiiya era ez'olubeerera n'okuwagira okukula n'okukulaakulana kwazo.
Okukola n'okuteeka mu nkola enteekateeka empya ez'obuweereza bw'okukuza emirimu eri bannamukago abayinza okusiga ensimbi ne kampuni z'Obwakabaka. Okufuula ebirowoozo ebipya emirimu egy'omuganyulo.
Okukulaakulanya n'okukozesa erinnya ly'Obwakabaka ku lw'omuganyulo gw'abantu ba Buganda.

Okuyamba Ebitongole by'Obwakabaka mu kuwandiika ebiteeso, okutegeka ebyanjulo by'emirimu (pitch deck), okukulaakulanya emirimu, okusonda ensimbi, awamu n'okubakwasaganya ne kampuni ezinywevu olw'emikisa gy'obusuubuzi.
Okutumbula endowooza y'obwannannyini mu mirimu mu bitongole by'Obwakabaka okusobola okwongera ku busobozi bw'obuyiiya.
divisions.summary: Okufuula Ebirowoozo Emirimu Egikulaakulana okusobola Okutumbula Enkulaakulana y'Obwakabaka. Tuwa amaanyi emirimu emipya n'enteekateeka z'obwannannyini mu bitundu eby'enjawulo nga tuyita mu buyambi obutegekeddwa okusinziira ku byetaago, okusiga ensimbi okw'enkizo, n'okukuza obuyiiya okuva ku nsigo okutuuka ku mutendera omunene.

divisions.title: Okulondoola n'Okwekenneenya
divisions.lead: Ofiisi y'Okulondoola n'Okwekenneenya (M&E) yatandikibwawo wansi w'Ekitongole ky'Emikago mu Buganda Investments and Commercial Undertakings Ltd.
paras: Omulimu gwayo omukulu kwe kukakasa nti obuvunaanyizibwa bwonna n'obweyamo obuli mu Ndagaano z'Okukwatagana (MOUs) ezissibwako emikono wakati w'Obwakabaka bwa Buganda ne bannamukago babwo biteekebwa mu nkola mu bujjuvu era ne bilondoolebwa okulaba ebivaamu.

Ofiisi eno ekola omulimu omukulu ennyo mu kutumbula enkolagana ey'omuganyulo eri enjuyi zombi, nga ekakasa nti Obwakabaka ne bannamukago babwo bombi bafuna omugaso ogulabika okuva mu nkolagana yaabwe.

Obwakabaka bukozesa emikago gino okutuusa obuweereza obwetaagisa n'enteekateeka z'enkulaakulana eri abantu babwo, nga butumbula ebitundu ebikulu nga ebyenjigiriza, ebyobulamu, ebyobulimi, obutonde bw'ensi, n'okuwa abavubuka amaanyi. Ate bannamukago bo bagasibwa nga beeyongera okumanyibwa, erinnya lyabwe ne lyeyongera okwesigibwa, n'okulabika obulungi mu bantu, kubanga balabibwa nga bayamba ku nteekateeka ez'amakulu ez'enkulaakulana y'ebitundu munda mu Bwakabaka.

Nga erondoola ebivaamu n'okwekenneenya enkulaakulana, Ofiisi ya M&E ekakasa obuvunaanyizibwa, okuyiga, n'okweyongera okulongoosa, ebibala by'emikago bireme kutuukirira kyokka wabula n'okuwangaala okumala ebbanga eddene.

impact.title: Enkolagana ez'Okukyusa Embeera z'Abantu
impact.heading: Okuleeta Enkyukakyuka mu Bwakabaka bwa Buganda nga tuyita mu Mikago egy'Enkizo
intro: Tukwaniriza ku nnyanjula ey'enjawulo eraga omukutu gw'Obwakabaka bwa Buganda ogweyongera okukula ogw'enkolagana ezikyusa embeera z'abantu — ennono gy'esisinkanira obuyiiya obw'omulembe okuleeta enkyukakyuka ey'amakulu.

Nga tuzzibwamu amaanyi enteekateeka yaffe ey'enkulaakulana, “Buganda ku Ntikko”, tweyongera okukwatagana ne bannamukago okuva mu nsi yonna okutegeka n'okuteeka mu nkola enteekateeka ezisitula ebitundu, ezikuuma obuwangwa, era ezitumbula enkulaakulana etwaliramu buli muntu.

blocks.x: Obwakabaka bwa Buganda bwatongoza kaweefube wa Mwanyi Terimba okulwanyisa obwavu n'okuwa ebitundu amaanyi nga biyita mu kulima emmwanyi. Kaweefube ono akyusizza obulamu bw'abantu, ayongedde ku nsimbi ez'amaka, era anywezezza eby'enfuna by'Obwakabaka eby'obulimi.

Mutundwe, olusozi olupapajjufu waggulu, lwe lumu ku nsozi musanvu ez'edda ezaakola Kampala. Ku buwanvu bwa mita 1,298 okuva ku gulumaliro ly'ennyanja, olusozi luno lwe lumu ku bifo ebisinga obugulumivu nga olaba wakati mu kibuga ekikulu okutuuka ku kiromita 9 mu njuyi zonna.
Obwakabaka bwa Buganda bwenyumiriza mu byafaayo n'obuwangwa obugagga obusoba mu myaka 800, ebizimbye ennono yaffe ey'ennaku zino, wamu n'empisa n'emitindo gyaffe.
Obwakabaka bwa Buganda bwe businga obunene mu bwakabaka obw'ennono mu Uganda ey'ennaku zino, nga butwaliramu ekitundu kya Uganda kyonna eky'Amasekkati, omuli n'ekibuga ekikulu ekya Uganda, Kampala.

Enteekateeka Enkulu ey'Obwakabaka bwa Buganda eraga obulagirizi obukulu ku nteekateeka zonna, n'emitendera egy'enjawulo egy'enkizo Obwakabaka gye bujja okuteeka mu nkola mu myaka etaano egijja.

Manya E Ssaza lyo” kyafulumizibwa okusobola okuwa ebibalo ebitegekeddwa okusinziira ku byetaago okulung'amya enkola, enteekateeka n'okusalawo mu Bwakabaka ne mu gavumenti z'ebitundu ebiri omwo (Amasaza n'Amagombolola).

Nkuluze emanyiddwa nga “Eggwanika ly'Obwakabaka” evunaanyizibwa okulabirira Obwakabaka (Obwakabaka bwa Kabaka). Kitongole kinene ennyo mu Bwakabaka bwa Buganda, ekikulemberwa Omuwanika ow'Obwakabaka, “Omuwanika w’Enkuluze”. Omuwanika oba “Omuwanika w’Enkuluze” alondebwa mu ofiisi eno Ssaabasajja Kabaka era abeera wa buvunaanyizibwa eri ye yekka. Oluvannyuma lw'obuzibu bwa 1966 mu Buganda, kumpi enteekateeka zonna, emirimu n'ofiisi byaggalwawo lwa mpaka obufuzi obwaliwo, omwali ne Nkuluze, kubanga Kabaka yali takyali ku Nnamulondo. Kyokka oluvannyuma lw'olutalo olw'okununula eggwanga olwa 1986, enteekateeka ez'okuzzaawo Obwakabaka bwa Buganda zaatandika, era ne wassibwawo akakiiko okulowooza ku ngeri Obwakabaka gye bwandiddukanyiziddwamu.

Okutandikibwawo kwa Muteesa I Royal University (MRU) kwaleetebwa era kwazzibwamu amaanyi Ssaabasajja Kabaka Muwenda Mutebi II, nga awagirwa nnyo Olukiiko Olukulu olw'Obwakabaka bwa Buganda olukulemberwa Katikkiro. Omusingi gwateekebwawo Akakiiko akaali kategeka Yunivasite ya Buganda (Buganda University Task Force – BUTF), akaatongozebwa Katikkiro nga 8 Juuni 2004 era ne kawaayo alipoota yaako esembayo nga 2 Desemba 2004. Muteesa I Royal University yunivasite erina ebbaluwa y'obuyinza (charter), etuumiddwa erinnya lya Kabaka Muteesa I owa Buganda (1856–1884), kabaka eyalina okulengera ewala, eyayita abaminsane Abakristaayo — nga yayita mu bbaluwa gye yawandiikira Nnaabakyala Victoria owa Bungereza — ekitwalibwa nnyo ng'entandikwa y'ebyenjigiriza eby'omulembe mu Uganda.

Lubiri High School yaggulwawo nga 8 Febwali 1999 Minisitule y'Ebyenjigiriza n'Emizannyo eya Gavumenti ya Buganda e Mengo. Kino kyava ku bwetaavu bw'okuwa obuweereza bw'ebyenjigiriza eri abantu ba Buganda ne Uganda yonna okutwalira awamu. Esangibwa mu Lubiri lwa Kabaka e Mengo. Lubiri High School egenderera okukuza omwana mu ngeri ey'enjuyi zonna nga eyita mu mirimu egy'enjawulo omuli emizannyo, obuyiiya mu tekinologiya, obuyiiya mu bwannannyini bw'emirimu, ennyimba, amazina n'emizannyo gy'oku siteegi. Ate era abaana benyigira mu mirimu gy'okuyamba ebitundu. Bakkiririza mu nteekateeka z'okuyamba abali mu bwetaavu munda n'ebweru w'essomero. Beeyongedde okukyalira abalwadde n'okugabana n'abali mu bwetaavu mu by'omwoyo, mu nsimbi ne mu bintu. Emirimu gino gikyusa essomero okukyusa enkola zaalyo okutuukiriza ebyetaago by'ekyasa ekya 21.

Mu Mwanyi Terimba Limited, tukkiriza nti omutindo gw'erinnya ly'emmwanyi tegusalibwawo buwoomi bwa kyai kyokka, wabula n'obwegendereza n'obunyiikivu ebiteekebwa mu buli mutendera gw'okukola. Okuva ku balimi abalima empeke, okutuuka ku basiika abazzaamu obuwoomi bwazo, okutuuka ku bakugu abakola buli kikopo (baristas) – buli mukono ogukwata ku mmwanyi zaffe gugabana obweyamo bwaffe obw'omutindo ogusinga. Kino kye kyawula Mwanyi Terimba mu nsi ejjudde amannya g'emmwanyi mangi.

Buganda Land Board (BLB) kitongole kya bakugu ekyatandikibwawo Ssaabasajja Kabaka wa Buganda okuddukanya ettaka n'ebintu ebyaddizibwa wansi w'Etteeka ery'Okuzzaayo Eby'obugagga n'Ebintu (Restitution of Assets and Properties Act) erya 1993.

Lubiri Nabagereka Nursery and Primary School esangibwa munda mu Lubiri lwa Kabaka e Mengo, nga erina oluggya olulungi olubeera olwa kiragala ebbanga lyonna, oluwa ekifo ekigazi ennyo ku lw'emisomo n'emirimu emirala egy'okuyiga. Nabagereka, essomero ery'Obwakabaka bwa Buganda, lyatandikibwawo wakati mu myaka gya 1940 okuwa ebyenjigiriza ebisookerwako eri abaana abato abaali mu lubiri n'okwetooloola, wansi w'obulabirizi bwa Nnaabagereka, ng'akabonero k'omulimu gwe ogw'obuzadde n'okulabirira abaana b'obwakabaka. Essomero lyasaanyizibwawo mu buzibu bw'ebyobufuzi obwa 1966, amagye bwe gaalumba ne gagoba Sir Edward Muteesa II ku ntebe.

body.x: Buganda Royal Institute of Business and Technical Education (BRIBTE) Mengo yatandikibwawo Obwakabaka bwa Buganda mu 1999 n'ekigendererwa ky'okuwa abayizi okumanya n'obukugu obw'enkola obubasobozesa okufuna emirimu. Ng'oggyeeko ekyo, Ettendekero limanyiddwa Ebitongole by'Ebigezo eby'Eggwanga era lyaweebwa ebifo by'ebigezo okuva mu Uganda Business and Technical Examinations Board (UBTEB) ne Directorate of Industrial Training (DIT).

Guno gwe mutendera ogusooka munteekateeka eno era twaniriza buli muntu ayagala okutambulira awamu naffe mu lugendo luno.

Nga esangibwa wakati mu Bwakabaka bwa Buganda, NIL kampuni eddukanya ebizimbe n'ettaka era ekola ku nkulaakulana y'amayumba n'ettaka, eyawandiisibwa wansi w'Amateeka ga Uganda Cap 110. Eri wansi w'obulabirizi bwa Minisita w'Ebyensimbi, Enteekateeka n'Enkulaakulana y'Eby'enfuna. Yatandikibwawo okusingira ddala okuddukanya ebizimbe n'ettaka by'Obwakabaka ebingi ebiri mu byalo bya Buganda, n'okwenyigira mu Nkulaakulana n'Okusiga Ensimbi mu Mayumba n'Ettaka. Namulondo Investments Limited era ewa obuweereza obw'enjawulo obukwata ku bizimbe n'ettaka eri abantu ba Kabaka, k'abe nga bali wa wonna, okubayamba okufuna amagoba amangi ku nsimbi ze basiga.
Ekigendererwa: Okuddukanya ebizimbe n'ettaka by'Obwakabaka mu ngeri ey'obukugu n'okwenyigira mu kusiga ensimbi n'enkulaakulana mu mayumba n'ettaka, nga bulijjo kakasa nti bakasitoma bamatira.

Majestic Brands Limited [MBL] kampuni erina obuvunaanyizibwa obukomye, eyatandikibwawo Obwakabaka bwa Buganda okukola emirimu egy'obuyiiya era egy'okuvuganya, okukozesa erinnya lya Buganda ku lw'omuganyulo gw'abantu ba Buganda. MBL kampuni ekola wansi wa Buganda Investments & Commercial Undertakings (BICUL), ekitongole ky'Obwakabaka ekirina emigabo, ekyatandikibwawo okufuna ensimbi nga kiyita mu kwenyigira mu mikisa gy'okusiga ensimbi egy'omuganyulo era egisaanidde, okuwa ensimbi oba okugattako ku nsimbi z'enteekateeka za Buganda ez'eby'enfuna, embeera z'abantu, n'obuwangwa.

Obwakabaka bwa Buganda bwatandikawo BUCADEF mu 1994 ng'Ekitongole Ekitali kya Gavumenti (No. S5914/1 432), ekitali kya byabufuzi, ekiri mu mateeka, ekirina obuvunaanyizibwa obw'enjawulo okukulembera n'okulung'amya enkulaakulana y'embeera z'abantu n'eby'enfuna mu bitundu. Kyatandikibwawo okutuuka ku kulongooka okw'olubeerera mu mbeera z'obulamu n'obulungi bw'abantu, ate n'okuzimba obusobozi bw'ebitundu okuwa obuweereza obw'omugaso okuleeta enkulaakulana ey'olubeerera. BUCADEF erina enteekateeka ez'enjawulo ezitegekeddwa mu nkola y'awamu ey'enkola ne nteekateeka za gavumenti ez'eby'enfuna eziriwo, omuli;

items: Enteekateeka z'eby'enfuna ezitegekeddwa okutondawo n'okugaziya emikisa gy'okufuna ensimbi, naddala ebyobulimi eby'olubeerera n'enkulaakulana y'emirimu, okusiga ensimbi n'emirimu gy'obusuubuzi.
Enteekateeka z'embeera z'abantu ezitegekeddwa okutumbula enkulaakulana y'ebitundu, okubeera n'emmere emala, obuweereza bw'ebyobulamu n'ebyenjigiriza, amazzi n'obuyonjo, n'ebizimbe eby'awamu.
Enteekateeka z'okuyamba ezigendereddwamu okuyamba ebibinja by'abantu ebiri mu bwetaavu.
Enteekateeka z'okuwagira ebikolebwa eziwagira okuteeka mu nkola enteekateeka ez'eby'enfuna, embeera z'abantu, n'okuyamba ezoogeddwako waggulu.

BBS kampuni ey'obwannannyini erina obuvunaanyizibwa obukomye, eyawandiisibwa mu Febwali 2018 nga esangibwa mu Kampala, Uganda. Buganda Broadcasting Service ye Ttivvi entongole ey'Obwakabaka bwa Buganda, erina obuvunaanyizibwa okukola n'okuleeta ebiweerezebwa ebimanyisa, ebisomesa, ebisanyusa, n'eby'obuwangwa mu bika byonna eri bakasitoma ab'enjawulo nga eyita ku mikutu gyaffe egy'enjawulo, nga bwe tulowooza ku byetaago n'enkyukakyuka ebikyuka mu by'amawulire.

news.title: Obwakabaka bwa Buganda ne UNICEF Bakkiriziganya ku Mukago Ogutumbula Eddembe n'Ebiseera eby'Omu Maaso eby'Abaana Obukadde 4.2

body.x: KAMPALA, UGANDA – 13 Novemba 2025 – Obwakabaka bwa Buganda, nga buyita mu Buganda Investment and Commercial Undertaking Ltd. (BICUL), ne United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF), leero bassizza omukono, mu Lukiiko lwa Buganda, ku Ndagaano y'Okukwatagana (MoU) ey'enkizo okutandikawo omukago omugazi ogwewaddeyo okulongoosa embeera n'okutuukiriza eddembe ly'abaana obukadde 4.2 mu kitundu kya Buganda.

Omukago guno gwesigamye ku kukkiriza nti buli mwana agwanidde okuwangaala, okukula obulungi, n'okutuukiriza obusobozi bwe bwonna. Nga tugatta eby'obugagga n'emirandira egy'amaanyi Obwakabaka gye bulina mu bantu n'obuyinza bwabwo mu buwangwa, awamu n'obukugu bwa UNICEF obw'ensi yonna, omukago guno gutegekeddwa okuleeta enkyukakyuka ennungi ey'olubeerera era etunuulira eby'omu maaso eri abaana.

Omwoyo gw'omukago guno gukwatagana nnyo n'endowooza ya Buganda ey'ennono eya Bulungi Bwansi — okukolera awamu ku lw'obulungi bwa bonna — era guyoleka emisingi emikulu egy'Endagaano y'Eddembe ly'Omwana.

Ku mukolo gw'okussa omukono ogwabadde leero, Katikkiro wa Buganda, Owek. Charles Mayiga, yalaze omugaso gw'omukago guno: “Engeri ekitundu gye kirabiriramu abaana baakyo ye nsalawo y'ebiseera byakyo eby'omu maaso. Omwana gwe musingi gw'obukulu, era obuvunaanyizibwa bwaffe tubutwala nga bwa nkomeredde. Omukago guno ne UNICEF tugutwala nga gwa muwendo nnyo kubanga gutusobozesa okukakasa mu bujjuvu obulamu n'endya ennungi ey'abaana, okukuuma abaana mu masomero, n'okubakuuma eri obutabanguko. Okukolera awamu kutusobozesa okugaziya amangu kaweefube waffe mu byenjigiriza, okugema endwadde, endya ennungi, n'ebyobulamu, nga tukakasa obulungi bw'omulembe ogujja ogwa Buganda.”
Endagaano y'Okukwatagana (MoU) essaawo obweyamo buna obukwatagana, kaweefube ow'awamu mw'agenda okussa essira ku nsonga ezikwata ku baana n'eddembe lyabwe, omuli:

items: Okuwonya obulamu bw'abaana: Okwongera ku kugema endwadde n'okukozesa emikutu gy'amawulire gy'Obwakabaka okugabana amawulire agawonya obulamu okukendeeza ku kufa okuyinza okwewalibwa n'endya embi.

Ebyenjigiriza eby'omutindo: Okumalawo ebiziyiza eri abaana abali mu bwetaavu. Okussa essira ku Nkulaakulana y'Abaana Abato, okutandika kaweefube w'okuzza abaana mu masomero, n'okuwa amaanyi Enkiiko z'Abavubuka za Kabaka.
Okukuuma abaana: Okumalawo okutulugunyizibwa, obutabanguko, obufumbo bw'abaana abato, n'embuto mu bawala abato. Okunyweza enkola z'okuwandiisa abazaalibwa n'okukolagana n'abakulembeze b'ennono.

Enkyukakyuka mu nneeyisa n'okusitula amaloboozi g'abaana: Okukyusa endowooza nga tuwa abaana emikutu okwogerera eddembe lyabwe, nga tubakkiriza ng'abaleeta enkyukakyuka, n'okulwanyisa empisa ez'obulabe mu bantu.

body.x: Omubaka wa UNICEF, Dr Robin Nandy, yalaze obwangu n'okulengera ewala okw'endagaano eno: “Endagaano eno y'Okukwatagana kisuubizo eri abaana b'Obwakabaka bwa Buganda ne Uganda. Tujja kubeera munnamukago omwesigwa, omutangaavu, era ow'ekitiibwa, nga tukakasa nti buli ssente esigiddwa evaamu okulongooka okulabika. Nga tuli wamu mu kuleeta enjawulo eri abaana, tuli ba maanyi okusinga ffe kinnoomu.“

Wajja kussibwawo Akakiiko k'Awamu Akalung'amya okutegeka enteekateeka y'emirimu okuteeka mu nkola obweyamo obwakolebwa mu Ndagaano y'Okukwatagana, okulondoola enkulaakulana y'emirimu egikolebwa, n'okuwandiika enkola ezitambudde obulungi eziyinza okugaziyizibwa n'okugabanwa.

news.title: Obwakabaka bwa Buganda Bussa Omukono ku MoU ne EACOP Okutumbula Okukuuma Obutonde bw'Ensi n'Enkulaakulana y'Ebitundu

body.x: Obwakabaka bwa Buganda bwenyumiriza okulangirira okussa omukono ku Ndagaano y'Okukwatagana (MoU) ne East African Crude Oil Pipeline (EACOP) Ltd., egendereddwamu okunyweza enkolagana mu kukuuma obutonde bw'ensi n'enkulaakulana y'ebitundu.
Omukago guno ogw'enkizo gussa essira ku nteekateeka bbiri enkulu:

items: Okutumbula okusimba emiti wansi wa Ekibira Kya Kabaka
Okuzimba ekifo ky'emizannyo eky'omulembe eky'abantu mu Ssaza Buddu, Disitulikiti y'e Masaka

body.x: Ng'ekitundu ku nkolagana eno, Obwakabaka buwaddeyo yiika z'ettaka 120 okuwagira okusimba emiti wansi wa kaweefube wa Ekibira Kya Kabaka, n'endala yiika 10 ez'okuzimbako ekifo ky'emizannyo eky'omulembe. EACOP ejja kuwaayo obuyambi bw'ensimbi ku kifo kino, ekijja okubeera ekifo eky'okukuza ebitone, okutumbula obulamu bw'omubiri, n'okuwa abavubuka amaanyi nga beenyigira mu mirimu gy'ebitundu.

Omukolo gw'okussa omukono gwabadde mu Bulange Mengo, Katikkiro waffe, Owek. Charles Peter Mayiga, gye yakkaatirizza obukulu bw'emikago egikola ku bizibu ebinyigiriza nga enkyukakyuka y'obudde, okukuuma obutonde bw'ensi, n'okuwa abavubuka amaanyi. Yagambye nti:

“Obwakabaka butwala nga bya muwendo emikago egikola ku bizibu eby'amangu nga enkyukakyuka y'obudde, okukuuma obutonde bw'ensi, n'okuwa abavubuka amaanyi. Nga tuyita mu Kibira Kya Kabaka n'ekifo ky'emizannyo ekipya eky'abantu, tutondawo obusika bw'okugumira embeera, emikisa, n'enkulaakulana eri abantu baffe.”
Ssenkulu wa EACOP, Mw. Guillaume DULOUT, yazzeemu okukakasa obweyamo bwabwe eri okuwangaala kw'obutonde n'enkulaakulana y'embeera z'abantu n'eby'enfuna, ng'agamba nti:

Twafunye ekitiibwa olw'okubeerawo kwa Hon. Ruth Nankabirwa, Minisita w'Amasannyalaze n'Eby'obugagga eby'omu Ttaka, eyasiimye enjuyi zombi olw'okukola omukago ogunyweza okukuuma obutonde bw'ensi n'enkulaakulana y'ebitundu.

Enkolagana eno ekwatagana n'empagi za EACOP ez'Okusiga Ensimbi mu Mbeera z'Abantu n'Eby'enfuna, ezissa essira ku kukuuma obutonde bw'ensi n'okuwa abavubuka amaanyi. Era ekkiriza omulimu omukulu Obwakabaka bwa Buganda gwe bukola mu lugendo lw'omudumu guno, kubanga disitulikiti 7 ku 10 omudumu mwe guyita ziri mu kitundu kyaffe, nga zitwaliramu ebyalo ebisoba mu 130 mu masaza ana.
Obwakabaka bwa Buganda bunywerera mu bweyamo bwabwo eri enteekateeka ezisitula abantu baffe, ezikuuma obutonde bwaffe, era ezizimba ebiseera eby'omu maaso ebigumu eri emirembe egijja.

Uganda Bureau of Statistics (UBOS) ekoze enkolagana entongole n'Obwakabaka bwa Buganda egendereddwamu okutandikawo ekitongole kya Buganda eky'ebibalo ekijja okusobozesa okuwanyisiganya ebibalo okukuuma omutindo gw'ebibalo mu kitundu eky'amasekkati. body.x: Obwakabaka bwa Buganda bwassa omukono ku Ndagaano y'Okukwatagana ne Health Hearts Foundation (HHF) nga 17 Marisi 2021, okuwa omukutu gw'okukolagana, n'ekigendererwa eky'awamu eky'okukulembeza okwewala endwadde z'omutima n'emisuwa (CVDs) ku mitendera egisooka, egy'okubiri n'egy'okusatu mu Uganda n'ebweru waayo, nga tuyita mu kwongera okumanyisa abantu, okuzuula endwadde nga bukyali, okutendeka, okwogerera abalwadde, n'okufuna obujjanjabi n'obuweereza obw'okuzza abalwadde engulu. Enkolagana eno ejja kwongera ku busobozi bw'abasawo abasookerwako mu malwaliro okuzzaamu abalwadde omukka (resuscitation), n'okuwagira enteekateeka z'okwogerera n'okunoonyereza ku ndwadde z'omutima mu Bwakabaka bwa Buganda ne Uganda yonna okutwalira awamu.

Housing Finance Bank ejja kuwola ensimbi ez'okugula amayumba ku magoba amatono ennyo okumala emyaka 10 eri bonna abandyagadde okufuna amayumba gano.

news.title: Okutongoza Kampuni ya Werind Royal Brokerage

body.x: Kampuni BICUL z'erina zeeyongedde n'okutongoza Werind Royal Brokerage Company, erina obuvunaanyizibwa okuwa obuweereza bw'obutunzi bw'yinsuwa. Obwakabaka bwa Buganda bwenyigidde mu by'ensimbi era tusuubira nti oluvannyuma lw'ekiseera, kampuni eno ejja kukula efuuke kampuni ey'obuweereza enzijuvu.

news.title: Obwakabaka bwa Buganda Bwassa Omukono ku MOU ne Minisitule y'Amazzi n'Obutonde bw'Ensi (MWE)

body.x: Obwakabaka bwa Buganda bwassa omukono ku Ndagaano y'Okukwatagana ne Minisitule y'Amazzi n'Obutonde bw'Ensi (MWE) nga 15 Sebuttemba 2021 okuwa omukutu gw'okukolagana wakati w'Obwakabaka bwa Buganda ne Minisitule y'Amazzi n'Obutonde bw'Ensi okutumbula n'okwogerera okukuuma amazzi, obutonde bw'ensi n'eby'obugagga eby'obutonde.

Omukago guno ogw'awamu gujja kuwa omukutu ogw'okukolagana okussaawo enkolagana enjuyi zombi mwe zinaakolera awamu pulojekiti/emirimu egikwata ku Mazzi, Obuyonjo n'Obukuumi bw'Obulamu (WASH), okuwagira abalimi abatono n'ab'omu makkati okukozesa tekinologiya mu kufukirira ebirime n'okunywesa ebisolo, omuli n'okukung'aanya amazzi g'enkuba mu biseera by'enkuba, okukozesa obulungi eby'obugagga eby'obutonde mu ngeri ey'olubeerera, n'okumanyisa abantu ku kukuuma amazzi n'obutonde bw'ensi.
